calls.title: Pricing Discussion
calls.summary: The team discussed a strategic shift to consumption-based pricing, retaining free and self-serve plans for small customers. Key discussions revolved around clearly segmenting customer types into free, pro, and enterprise tiers to enhance packaging and conversion clarity. Ashley Stirrup emphasized creating distinct mental models for each customer tier and improving onboarding processes. Significant revenue opportunities, particularly through event forwarding for enterprise customers, were identified. There was debate on the conversion frequency of SMB/pro customers to enterprise, with recommendations for aligning tiers with company types. Pricing structures will include limits on features to encourage upgrades, and existing billing anomalies that could impact revenue were flagged for investigation, with plans for better pricing models and customer feedback mechanisms.
calls.keywords: pricing strategy, customer segmentation, consumption-based pricing, enterprise acquisition, managed warehouse, event forwarding
